definition_of_done: Read each rendered page as a first-time customer and write a one-sentence plain-language summary of what it offers.
Reject unexplained product, legal, technical, workflow, or metaphorical terms; familiar customer language is allowed.
Reject headings or calls to action that require internal product vocabulary to understand.
Reject sentences that sound impressive but cannot be paraphrased accurately after one read.
Require the customer benefit before implementation details and name the exact confusing phrase in every issue.

Write the review artifact with schema_version product_factory.public_copy_review.v1, review_type customer_clarity, reviewer_agent_id customer_clarity_review_agent, status verified, the current product_id and build_id, and reviewed_routes containing every declared public route exactly once.
Review every declared public route at desktop and mobile widths in its rendered context.
When the reviewer sandbox cannot bind a preview port, use retained root-managed screenshots only when copy-review-evidence records the exact route, viewport, and matching rendered title and heading.
Record one route_reviews entry per public route with route, plain_language_summary, customer_outcome, unexplained_terms, and passed.
Set decision to approved only when every route passes, unexplained_terms is empty, checks_passed is non-empty, and checks_failed and issues are empty.
forbidden_scope: frontend source, product behavior, or strategy source; the independent reviewer reports defects but does not repair its own findings
approving copy merely because it is grammatical, distinctive, or keyword-rich
inventing customer evidence, performance, reviews, rankings, revenue, or legal conclusions
treating an undefined product metaphor as familiar customer language
task.objective: Independently verify that a busy first-time customer can understand every public page on the first read, without knowing the product's internal vocabulary.
task.title: Review QuoteRivet for first-read customer clarity
